name: GLB Viewer
summary: Loads and displays 3D GLB models in an interactive viewport. Can capture the viewport as a 2D image.

inputs.description: GLB model URL from upstream 3D generation node

outputs.description: Captured viewport screenshot as base64 image (when capture is triggered)

executionNotes: Loads a GLB model from URL and renders it in an interactive Three.js or Babylon.js viewport. Users can rotate, zoom, and pan the model. The 'capturedImage' output can be generated by clicking a capture button to save the current viewport as a PNG/JPEG image.

exampleConnections.scenario: View 3D model output from Kie 3D generation API
Compare captured 3D viewport with other images
